sourceTitle: Happy Jack, and Other Tales of the Sea
description: "Happy Jack, and Other Tales of the Sea" by William Henry Giles Kingston is a collection of maritime adventure stories written in the mid-19th century. The narrative follows the young and lively protagonist, known as "Happy Jack," who embarks on a journey at sea, eager to explore the world and prove his mettle.
